title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder 14.4-Inch Solid Brass Countertop Stand | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your countertop with a freestanding paper towel holder from the Carolina collection, crafted from solid brass and designed to keep your roll upright in a space-saving footprint.

  • Freestanding convenience: no wall mounting required
  • Stable on the counter: weighted base helps keep the stand steady while tearing sheets
  • Solid brass construction: crafted from the finest solid brass materials
  • Surface protection: felt pad helps prevent scratching on countertops
  • Designer finish: built for corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specs

  • Collection: Carolina (traditional/classic)
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Assembly required: No
  • Overall size: 6.5-Inch L x 6.5-Inch W x 14.4-Inch H (projection 6.5-Inch)
  • Product weight: 4 lb; weight capacity: 5 lb
  • Included: Paper towel holder
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available for matching Carolina pieces

_previous.title: Carolina Collection Counter Top Paper Towel Stand
_previous.description: Elegantly hold your paper towel roll on this classic traditional design paper towel stand. Its design is as functional as it is practical. The roll in the stand sits upright on the counter top allowing for space saving. It has a weight in the base to keep the unit stable as you tear off the sheets.
